_comment: Pinned release signing keys (squirrelscan/repo#5032). install.sh and `squirrel self update` accept a release
binary if EITHER its GitHub attestation OR an ECDSA P-256 signature from one of these keys verifies.
id = first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over the key's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo; pem = the PEM public key.
Two slots, current and next, so a rotation can pin the next key before releases switch to it.
A slot with an empty pem is unused. While BOTH are empty the signature path is off and both installers
behave exactly as before (attestation, else the sha256 checksum alone with a warning).
the maintainer adds squirrelscan-release.pub here; see #5032
After editing run: bun run scripts/sync-install-header.ts (install.sh carries a generated copy).
